text: Cream from the centrifuge is standardised to at least 15 % and UHT-treated, which gives it a longer shelf life in the portion cup. Stabilisers keep it from feathering in hot coffee.

steps.note: The cream is heated to ultra-high temperature for a few seconds, which gives it a longer shelf life.
The cream is kept from curdling on the acids and tannins of coffee.
